newsitem.title: USA: 3M says near deal on China highway products plant.
newsitem.headline: 3M says near deal on China highway products plant.

text.p: Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co is close to finalizing a deal to build a plant in China to make highway safety products such as reflective sheeting, a company spokesman said on Friday.

"I can definitely tell you it is certainly under consideration -- building a factory in China to make highway safety products, essentially," said 3M's Chris Welsh, "It's not an absolutely done deal to my knowledge at this point."
He said 3M executives were in China discussing the deal and could have final approval as early as late today.
He said a published report that the plant would cost $60 million was "not accurate." He called that estimate high but declined to be more specific.
"If this goes through, we're going to be developing a new site," Welsh said. "It's a bigger thing than we've had in the past there...this would be our single biggest thing to date in China."
The plant, which Welsh said could be on-line in 1998, would tap "new opportunities" and serve the China market.
"We would not be moving product over there that currently takes place somewhere else," he added. "This is new stuff."
